title: The Outlaws’ Hideout
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into the book. In Chapters 8 and 9, the outlaws hide the boys in a hut in the forest. Find a spot where a hut could hide, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is the outlaws’ hiding place in the forest, from Chapters 8 and 9. Hold-Your-Nose Billy says, “We’re well hid, Cutwater.” This time you don’t build. You find a place.

lookfors.name: Trees close together
lookfors.why: so no one can see in

lookfors.name: Deep shade
lookfors.why: so it is hard to spot

lookfors.name: Room for a small hut
lookfors.why: where the outlaws keep the boys

steps.title: Know what to look for
steps.text: You won’t build today. You will find a good hiding spot. Read the four things to look for. This list is also in VR: open your menu, click the **Canvas** tab, then pick our assignment.

steps.title: Go in
steps.text: Put on your headset and open the **On-Demand** app. Click the **Explore** tab. Type **Forest** in the **Filter environments** box and click **Medieval Forest**. Then click **Begin Solo**.

steps.title: Find it
steps.text: Walk and teleport through the forest. Find a spot with trees close together, far from the path, in deep shade, with room for a small hut.

steps.title: Look closely
steps.frame: “This is a good hideout because ___. The king’s soldiers would not find it because ___.”
steps.text: Stand in your spot and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Stand in your spot and say this out loud. This is a good hideout because… and finish the sentence. The king’s soldiers would not find it because… and finish that one too.

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the trees around your hiding spot

extra.text: Find a spot that would be a **bad** hideout. Say why the outlaws would not hide there.

points: Your photo shows a hidden spot with trees close together, away from the path.

mapday.intro: No headset today? That’s okay. It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about the hideout.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Think about who talks like that in Chapters 8 and 9.
mapday.done: ✓ You found every speaker. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: The outlaws’ hut in the forest, with a spot for each person who talks
